_meta.labeler: hand-labeled from source_sentence; all 13 table values verified against the Docling markdown cache (.docling_cache/053c8fa42025e850_all.json, p34 wind-projects table: header 'Total capacity (100%), MWac' confirmed, section split in-operation vs under-construction confirmed)
_meta.source_extraction: backend/test_results/reingest/shell_2022.jsonl (Docling table path + llama-3.3-70b, post quality-gate + ontology expansion, Shell Sustainability Report 2022, 247 claims)
_meta.purpose: OUT-OF-SAMPLE validation of the 96.1 in-sample score (gold v0.2 was Tata-only and the ontology/gate rules were tuned on it). Different company, different report style (narrative-heavy IR-style vs Indian BRSR forms).
_meta.how_labeled: 50 claims, stratified 13 table (all that exist) / 37 text (random.seed(42)). Truth-first aspects: where the taxonomy lacks a node (offsets, CCS, intensity, EV charging, lobbying, payments-to-governments, stakeholder engagement, SIF rate, investment) the gold aspect names the correct concept under the correct pillar, so node_acc penalizes force-fits while pillar_acc credits the pillar. SASB p74 multi-year rows flattened to '49 58 61 67 69' with no year in the label are value_ambiguous (5-column row, most-recent-first order not stated in the sentence).
